description: Marks scored essays approved (the teacher stands behind the score), or unapproves them with approve: false. Accepts essay handles, or all: true for every scored essay not yet approved. Only approved essays go to Google Classroom. The same handles with approve: false reverse approval.

sessionId.description: Grading session id from list_grading_sessions or create_grading_session.
